replies.author: @Reallifeinsights.26
replies.text: Haha, "unapproachable" is just the quiet exterior! Finns deeply respect personal space and don't do fake small talk, but once you break the ice (usually over a sauna, coffee, or shared hobby), they are some of the most loyal, warm, and genuine people you'll ever meet!
